sources.content: The ellowen-collector image packages the Ellowen metrics collector, which scrapes targets and forwards samples to long-term storage. It is built on gcr.io/distroless/static and runs as user ID 65532. The collector exposes its own status page and metrics on port 9099. Scrape targets are listed in /etc/ellowen/targets.yaml. Mount a volume at /var/lib/ellowen/wal to keep the write-ahead log, which holds samples that have not yet been forwarded. On SIGTERM the collector stops scraping and flushes pending samples before it exits.

ELLOWEN_REMOTE_URL sets the storage endpoint and has no default; the collector exits at startup if it is missing. ELLOWEN_SCRAPE_INTERVAL defaults to 30s. ELLOWEN_WAL_MAX_SIZE caps the write-ahead log and defaults to 2GB; when it is full, the oldest samples are dropped. Because the base image has no shell, the image defines no HEALTHCHECK; use a probe against /ready instead. The entrypoint is /ellowen with the argument --config=/etc/ellowen/collector.yaml. Set ELLOWEN_LOG_FORMAT to json or text; it defaults to text.
